title: The Sabbath rhythm now keeps Saturday
body: The weekly Sabbath is now set to Saturday — the seventh day (Genesis 2:2–3; Exodus 20:8–11). It's simpler now: there's no day to choose.

title: Music that stays with you
body: The meditation music can now play softly throughout the whole app — while you read, pray, and study, not just during a sitting. Tap the speaker button (bottom-right) to pause it anytime, or turn it off in Settings.

title: A gentle welcome when you open the app
body: The installed app now opens with a quiet moment — a drop meeting still water, and a soft touch of the meditation music. Tap to enter. You can turn it off anytime in Settings.

title: A new sitting: Evening Rest
body: A gentle Compline to close the day — lay down its weight and rest in Psalm 4:8, “In peace I will lie down and sleep.” Find it among the guided sittings.

title: Share a verse as an image
body: Turn any verse into a quiet Still Waters image — tap Share on the daily verse or any verse in the Bible tab, then send it or save it.

title: 2 Enoch joins the Enoch tab
body: The Slavonic Book of Enoch — all 68 chapters — now reads beside 1 Enoch. Tap between the two, offline and all.

title: Notifications have arrived
body: A quiet inbox, a daily verse, and gentle nudges — on your phone if you invite them.
